state.claim: New Zealand’s new Food Bill bans gardening
state.query: Search legislation.govt.nz and the New Zealand Parliament bills database for the official Food Bill title, number, version and status as of 2020-10-29.

candidates.snippet: This website is the official home for New Zealand Acts, Bills, and secondary legislation. Find and use legislation. Get answers to legislation questions. Acts ...

candidates.title: About Bills
candidates.snippet: Bills are proposed Acts. Learn more about Bills, the stages of Bill review and how to read and understand Bills.

candidates.title: Legislation: NZ
candidates.snippet: New Zealand Legislation website declared official by the Chief Parliamentary Counsel, as well as the PDF format version.

candidates.title: Bills (proposed laws) - New Zealand Parliament
candidates.snippet: You can view the schedule of divided bills, or read more about the progress of legislation. Historical bills from 1854 to 2008 are available from NZLII.

candidates.title: NZ historic bills archive now online
candidates.snippet: All bills from 1949 to 2008 are available in the NZ Historical Bills collection on the New Zealand Legal Information Institute (NZLII) website.
